title: Care Management
description: Care Management documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers care management workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Query
subtasks.purpose: Surface patients who need outreach (missed uploads, abnormal readings, unanswered care-plan items) using the same filter set as Lookup Patient.

steps.title: Open Follow-Up Query
steps.description: Click Care Mgmt in the sidebar, then Follow Up.

steps.title: Enter Patient Name
steps.description: Enter any combination of Last Name, First Name.

steps.title: Pick Filters
steps.description: Pick Practice (scoped to the current practice), Provider, Caregiver and Status.

steps.title: Run or Reset Query
steps.description: Click Query to load the follow-up list; use Reset to clear all filters.

steps.title: Narrow Results Further
steps.description: Use the top-right Search box to filter the returned rows.

steps.title: Sort by Name
steps.description: Click the Name header to sort ascending / descending.

steps.title: Act on Follow-Up Row
steps.description: Use the Action icons in each row to open the patient dashboard, record a follow-up note or dismiss the alert. Notes The thresholds that decide who is flagged live in Settings → Follow Up Setting (minimum days since last upload, minimum readings, escalation window). Dismissing a follow-up here does not delete the underlying missed-upload / abnormal-reading events — it only removes the row from the outreach queue. Task 7.13 — Calendar
